errors.evidence: The chart displays two types of lines for each category: solid lines for actual data and dotted lines with markers for trends. The description fails to mention this crucial distinction, treating them as a single entity, which leads to significant misinterpretation of the data.

errors.text_span: постепенно намалява до около 108000 хиляди лева през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly states that the orange line gradually decreases. In reality, the solid orange line fluctuates, peaking in 2019, dipping in 2020, and then rising to approximately 120,000 in 2022. The description seems to be following the dotted trend line, not the actual data line.

errors.text_span: започва с около 22000 хиляди лева през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The yellow line (Рециклиране на материали) starts at a value of approximately 48,000 in 2018, not 22,000.

errors.text_span: и достига до около 32000 хиляди лева през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The yellow line (Рециклиране на материали) ends at a value of approximately 50,000 in 2022, not 32,000.

errors.text_span: започва с приблизително 40000 хиляди лева през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The solid gray line (Обработване и обезвреждане на отпадъци) starts at approximately 60,000 in 2018, not 40,000. The value 40,000 is closer to the starting point of the dotted trend line.

errors.text_span: нараства до около 58000 хиляди лева през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The solid gray line (Обработване и обезвреждане на отпадъци) ends at approximately 105,000 in 2022, not 58,000.
Only the dotted trend lines have circular markers. The solid lines, which represent the primary data, do not have markers.
